verdict.rationale: Bolna documents self-hosting on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes (bolna-docs-9), and its GitHub repository describes Bolna as an end-to-end open-source, production-ready framework (bolna-gh-1). Together these show the product itself can run outside Bolna's cloud. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting steps beyond the page summary, clarity on whether self-hosting is enterprise-gated or matches the hosted feature set, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
